gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-serif-georgi: Bold and playful up top, with letters held open like neon tubing. Noto Serif Georgian underneath is a classic serif with coiled, rope-swollen lowercase, and its subdued contrast gives the pair a literary weight that Grandstander's loud, uniform lines lean against.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-serif-granth: Chunky, bright, flat-lined headings with short ascenders. Grandstander keeps every curve at one flat width while Noto Serif Grantha eases its weight gradually, so the loud top and the refined, oversized-looking small letters below each get their own space.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-serif-gujara: Grandstander never tapers where its strokes meet or end. Noto Serif Gujarati has just a gentle modulation and oversized e and a counters, which makes the pair feel like a shouted headline over a patient, bookish voice.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-serif-gurmuk: Loud monoline shapes, tall and friendly. Noto Serif Gurmukhi brings the opposite: a generous x-height and subtle pen-like modulation in the bowls, and that gap between marker-flat heading and gradual-weight text is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-serif-hebrew: Grandstander looks traced with a single marker tip, short in its ascenders but tall in its x-height, and every line holds one weight. Noto Serif Hebrew keeps its thinnest strokes sturdy over long lines of text.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-serif-kannad: Noto Serif Kannada brings big counters in a tall lowercase, with a modest taper like a sharpened carpenter's pencil line. Grandstander's matching arch-and-stem n shapes sit up top as a bold, expressive contrast.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-serif-khmer: Noto Serif Khmer is traditional and authoritative, with tall lowercase sitting very close to the capitals and only modest hairline thinning at the curves. Its restrained rhythm holds steady paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-serif-khojki: Stencil-flat, loud and friendly. Grandstander uses single-weight strokes, while Noto Serif Khojki sets short ascenders above big bowls with horizontals a notch lighter than its uprights, so the refined text feels like a quiet answer to the bold heading.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-serif-lao: Big lowercase height against small capitals makes the body feel bookish and sure of itself. Noto Serif Lao has crossbars a bit finer than its stems, so a long passage moves along with gentle weight shifts beneath Grandstander's uniform strokes.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-serif-makasa: Tall, bold, and cheerfully blunt. Grandstander keeps diagonals as thick as horizontals, while Noto Serif Makasar softens from heavy to light without razor hairlines, so its body size can stay modest despite the towering x-height.
